**How We Hire**
---------------


Everyone is welcome at M\&S. No exceptions. It’s your background, abilities and differences that make you, uniquely you. And when you’re part of M\&S, that individuality has the potential to make waves.


**About the role**
------------------


This section tells you all you need to know about the position and its responsibilities, outlining everything we hope to see in a successful candidate.


All the details
We're changing the way we do things, and putting industry leading innovation at the heart of how we operate; we need a stellar engineering team to make it happen. You'll be joining one of the most iconic brands in the UK on its most exciting cycle yet. We're more integrated and product led in our tech teams than ever before: learning, changing, and adapting constantly, with millions of people benefiting from your work every single day.


You’ll be joining the M\&S Platform team as a Software Engineering Manager. Our mission is to streamline development at M\&S for 200\+ engineers and 30\+ applications \- covering both our customer\-facing and colleague\-facing applications.


You will manage the team building the AI Engineering platform. You will support the team and help direct the technical vision for how we will build reusable pipelines, tooling, build plugins and frameworks that our many apps will harness to boost the developer experience, while contributing code every step of the way.


We want to make M\&S one of the best places for software development, target the latest tooling and enable our engineers to focus on building the best user experience so that they don’t get held up by common engineering and continuous integration problems.

**What You'll Do**

* Being accountable for engineering excellence within your teams, from behaviours to operations, from technical direction to solution in production and from skills and growth to reputation.
* Cultivating self\-management and accountability throughout the team via leadership, clear sense of purpose and thoughtful talent management.
* Lead alignment with the overarching technical strategy and working with the wider Technology organisation to craft it.
* Act as a platform owner, apply accurate product thinking to what is being built with a view to enable and empower as much as possible the digital product(s) that it supports through data and customer centricity, driving the related partner management.
* Collaborate with the entire engineering leadership, to make us think strategically, to ensure maximum alignment and to maintain a healthy ability to “think big” within their teams.
* Line management of supporting Staff and Senior Engineers, as well as driving recruitment and retention within the team.
* Act as custodian of OKR’s within your hub.
* Supports our engineering communities to drive bar raising and strategic alignment, by creating the space and time within teams for the agenda of these communities to be progressed efficiently.
* When vendors are involved, the SEM is positioned as the key technical partner. They own it as a vital part of their platform with the same level of reliability and satisfaction as the in\-house capabilities they build and run.

**Who You Are**

* Previous polyglot hands\-on senior software engineer
* Excellent knowledge in AI coding tools and agentic technologies
* Extensive background in software engineering with several years’ experience in a variety of systems and technologies
* Experience building and leading teams of highly skilled, senior software engineers that deliver high\-quality software.
* Excellent understanding of system design, software architecture, cloud, and software engineering standard methodologies,
* Promoter of DevOps: you build it, you run it.
* Strong understanding of testing strategies and reliability engineering
* Excellent people management, interpersonal, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to lead and line manage senior engineers and technical partners to a desired outcome, without prescribing it.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken and able to adjust for different, including non\-technical audiences.
* A servant\-leadership mentality that is willing to take ownership of problems.
* Able to influence people at senior levels and from the highly technical to non\-technical

**Our Tech Stack**

* Azure cloud services, identity, networking, and security
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM
* Kubernetes, containers, and platform orchestration
* CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, and deployment automation
* Developer portals, golden paths, templates, and self\-service tooling
* Observability, reliability, cost management, and operational excellence
* Secure access control, governance, and compliance

**What’s In It For You**


Working at M\&S means being part of something bigger \- helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast\-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.


Here are just a few of the benefits that make working here even more rewarding:

* 20% colleague discount on all M\&S products and many third\-party brands for you and someone in your household, available once you’ve completed your probation
* Competitive holiday allowance with the option to buy more
* Discretionary bonus schemes linked to your performance and ours
* Strong pension and life assurance to help plan for the future
* Tailored induction and training to support your development from day one
* Exclusive perks and savings through our M\&S Choices portal
* Market\-leading family policies, including parental, adoption and neonatal leave
* 24/7 wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and mental health services
* One paid volunteer day a year to support a cause that matters to you

**Everyone’s Welcome**


We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks \& Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

Founded in 2012 by Daniel Gilbert, we were built by engineers before we were a media agency. Today, 1,000\+ Brainlabbers across five continents use our proprietary agents, built on 32 media tools and over 2,500 logged experiments, to help brands connect every channel they plan and buy to one thing: the bottom line. As the Director, Data Science, you will lead Brainlabs' Marketing Mix Modelling capability, overseeing the deployment of Google Meridian and other advanced modelling projects for our clients. You are accountable for the technical rigour of our data science output and for translating complex statistical findings into clear, commercially actionable insight that clients can use to make better decisions with their media budgets. Working at the intersection of advanced analytics and senior client engagement, you will build our data science practice and establish Brainlabs as the agency partner that makes MMM work in practice, through to model calibration, scenario planning, and insight presentation. * **Develop and Deliver Modelling Projects:** You scope and lead a broader range of data science engagements beyond MMM, identifying where advanced modelling can solve real client problems and designing solutions that are technically sound and commercially relevant. * **Translate Complexity Into Action:** You distil the outputs of complex statistical models into narratives that senior client stakeholders can understand and act on, connecting model findings directly to media budget decisions and business strategy. * **Drive AI Adoption Across the Team:** You lead the integration of AI tools, including Claude, into the data science team's ways of working — from accelerating code development and model documentation to improving how technical outputs are packaged and communicated to clients. * **Own Senior Client Relationships:** You are Brainlabs' senior data science point of contact for key clients, presenting findings and recommendations at CMO and VP level and building confidence in our analytical approach. * **Build and Lead the Data Science Team:** You manage and develop a team of data scientists, setting technical standards, running structured development conversations, and ensuring the team's output meets the quality bar the practice needs. * **Grow the Practice:** You drive the development of Brainlabs' data science proposition, contributing to new business pitches, publishing thought leadership, and building the processes that allow the practice to scale. ### **Who you are** * **An MMM Expert:** You have extensive, hands\-on experience with Marketing Mix Modelling, including working knowledge of Meridian, Robyn, and/or PyMC, and a track record of delivering MMM projects that have driven real client decisions. * **Technically Proficient:** You are fluent in Python and experienced with GCP, with a strong grounding in Bayesian statistics and the principles underpinning modern media attribution. * **AI\-Forward:** You actively explore how AI tools can augment data science practice, from speeding up code development and model documentation to helping non\-technical stakeholders engage more confidently with complex outputs. * **A Skilled Communicator of Complexity:** You can take the output of a sophisticated model and tell a story with it that a CMO finds compelling and a media team can act on, without sacrificing the integrity of the underlying analysis. * **An Experienced Team Leader:** You have led teams of data scientists, with a genuine commitment to their development and a clear view of what good technical mentorship looks like. * **Commercially Astute:** You understand how data science creates commercial value for clients and for Brainlabs, and connect technical decisions to business outcomes in conversations with senior stakeholders. * **A Practitioner\-Leader:** You remain close to the technical work, not just the management of it, and hold yourself to the same standard of rigour you expect from your team. ### **How you succeed** * **Client Outcomes:** Clients can point to specific budget decisions informed by your modelling work, and you can evidence the incremental value delivered through the projects you lead. * **Model Quality:** Every MMM deployment you oversee meets a documented quality standard, with calibration, validation, and scenario outputs that you and your team can defend under scrutiny. * **Clear Communication:** Your data science outputs land with senior client stakeholders, evidenced by positive feedback and by clients returning to Brainlabs for further analytical work. * **AI Adoption:** You achieve documented AI adoption across the data science team's workflows, with clear evidence of time saved or quality improved as a result. * **Team Development:** The data scientists in your team are growing in capability, and you can point to specific examples of how your leadership has raised their technical standards or broadened their skills. * **Practice Growth:** You contribute to at least one new business pitch per quarter and publish thought leadership that builds Brainlabs' data science credentials in the market. * **Commercial Impact:** The data science practice grows its revenue and client base under your leadership, and you can evidence progress against agreed commercial targets over time. **What happens next?** We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. * Research and plan creative campaigns that will excite the media to link back to key categories of the website, while adhering to brand guidelines.
* Write press materials and outreach emails ensuring everything is engaging and SEO optimised, with multiple angles and hooks to ensure we reach our link goals, ready for approval by the Digital PR Lead.
* Source relevant press contacts for all Digital PR activities and continually add to our internal media lists, while managing relationships with journalists.
* Acquire high quality and relevant backlinks through various Digital PR tactics, including campaigns, reactive PR, and link reclamation, while trying to minimise affiliate link acquisition.
* Amplify campaigns through influencers to reach more customers and gain additional traffic to the website.
* Work with Press Officers in the PR and social media teams to optimise press materials ensuring that we are maximising link opportunities in all outreach to media.
Spend time each week monitoring industry news, the media landscape and social media to understand trends and opportunities for Digital PR.  
* 

**Who you are**

  

* Excellent written and communication skills, able to write press materials to a high standard, with an excellent grasp on English spelling, punctuation and grammar.
* Demonstratable experience in a digital PR or influencer marketing role, either at an agency or client\-side with proven results of media placements and hitting campaign KPIs.
* Ideally you will have experience using a variety of media databases e.g. Muckrack, Press Loft, Buzzstream and their competitors, with awareness of SEO tools (such as Ahrefs).
* Desirable to have experience in a complex fashion, beauty or homeware retail business with high SEO traffic.
* Really strong organisational and time management skills.

**Everyone's Welcome**


We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks \& Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.If you feel you'd benefit from any support or reasonable adjustments during any stage of the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know when completing your application. This information will be picked up by our team, so we can try and put steps in place to help you be at your best through this process.\#LI\-CA1

jobs.description: Jun 26, 2026 **About WPP** WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com. Step into the forefront of marketing brilliance as our next Account Director, where your strategic vision and commercial acumen will shape the future of global brand experiences. In this role, you’ll unlock the power of cutting\-edge CRM systems and high\-impact campaigns, catalysing growth for some of the world’s most recognizable global brands. If you thrive on managing complex, large\-scale client relationships, have a passion for data\-driven customer journeys, and possess a deep understanding of premium brand ecosystems, your leadership is the missing ingredient in our recipe for success. **What will your day look like?** --------------------------------- We are seeking a highly commercially minded Account Director to drive CRM strategy, stakeholder management, and the growth of our global marketing operations. You will be the trusted advisor to major global clients, guiding them on how to optimize customer engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value through sophisticated CRM initiatives. You will lead the client roadmap, orchestrate multi\-channel campaign strategies, and oversee a dedicated delivery team. In this role, you must be a master of data\-driven decision\-making, possess a deep understanding of CRM best practices, and excel at managing senior stakeholders on a global scale. More specifically, your tasks include: * Leading and developing (CRM) and loyalty initiatives for major global brands. * Focusing on enhancing sophisticated, personalized client communication strategies. * Managing global client relationships, acting as a strategic partner and driving growth and organic business development. * Developing project scopes, complex plans, and budgets, ensuring commercial viability and profitability. * Producing high\-quality presentations for executive\-level client meetings. * Team leadership; directly managing and mentoring a team of project managers. * Cultivating a high\-performing team culture, defining clear roles, objectives, and career growth paths. **Who are you going to work with?** ----------------------------------- You will be the linchpin in a network of closely coordinated project managers, developers, data scientists, and experienced designers. You will work alongside competent teammates from all around the world who always go the extra mile to help one another. We are a flat organization that loves growing the talents of our people, and many of our team members have been with the agency for a decade or longer. **What do you bring to the table?** ----------------------------------- We are on the lookout for a senior, strategic\-minded individual with a proven track record of managing large\-scale global accounts. You are proactive in initiating campaigns that not only meet but surpass client expectations regularly. You are an easy\-going person with a proactive, positive mindset and the resilience to navigate the complexities of global matrix organizations. As you will be overseeing several workstreams simultaneously, you are highly organized and can keep the big picture in focus while showing great attention to detail. In addition, you have: * 8\+ years of experience in Account Management or Project Management within CRM, digital marketing, or a related agency environment. * Proven experience working with large global brands (experience in the luxury and/or automotive sectors is a massive advantage). * Extensive experience leading teams and managing senior stakeholders across complex, global departments. * Deep knowledge of what working with data, technical projects, and enterprise marketing automation platforms entails. * Experience with the strategic management and implementation of IT projects within CRM, web, and/or marketing automation. * Strong hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms, ideally Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Adobe Marketing Cloud. * The competence, confidence, and self\-discipline to manage deadlines, estimates, and budgets excellently. * Exceptional communication and presentation skills in English. **A leader in personalized customer experiences** ------------------------------------------------- VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. Together, we are 1000 \+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55\+ nationalities. **A global network** -------------------- We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150\+ offices in 60\+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. \#LI\-EMEA WPP (VML MAP) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML MAP on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn *and* *X**.* When you click “Apply now” below, your information is sent to VML MAP. To learn more about how we process your personal data during when you apply for a role with us, on how you can update your information or have the information removed please read our Privacy policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Account Director
raw.description:
Jun 26, 2026


**About WPP**


WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.


Step into the forefront of marketing brilliance as our next Account Director, where your strategic vision and commercial acumen will shape the future of global brand experiences. In this role, you’ll unlock the power of cutting\-edge CRM systems and high\-impact campaigns, catalysing growth for some of the world’s most recognizable global brands. If you thrive on managing complex, large\-scale client relationships, have a passion for data\-driven customer journeys, and possess a deep understanding of premium brand ecosystems, your leadership is the missing ingredient in our recipe for success.


**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------


We are seeking a highly commercially minded Account Director to drive CRM strategy, stakeholder management, and the growth of our global marketing operations. You will be the trusted advisor to major global clients, guiding them on how to optimize customer engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value through sophisticated CRM initiatives.


You will lead the client roadmap, orchestrate multi\-channel campaign strategies, and oversee a dedicated delivery team. In this role, you must be a master of data\-driven decision\-making, possess a deep understanding of CRM best practices, and excel at managing senior stakeholders on a global scale.


More specifically, your tasks include:


* Leading and developing (CRM) and loyalty initiatives for major global brands.
* Focusing on enhancing sophisticated, personalized client communication strategies.
* Managing global client relationships, acting as a strategic partner and driving growth and organic business development.
* Developing project scopes, complex plans, and budgets, ensuring commercial viability and profitability.
* Producing high\-quality presentations for executive\-level client meetings.
* Team leadership; directly managing and mentoring a team of project managers.
* Cultivating a high\-performing team culture, defining clear roles, objectives, and career growth paths.

**Who are you going to work with?**
-----------------------------------


You will be the linchpin in a network of closely coordinated project managers, developers, data scientists, and experienced designers. You will work alongside competent teammates from all around the world who always go the extra mile to help one another. We are a flat organization that loves growing the talents of our people, and many of our team members have been with the agency for a decade or longer.


**What do you bring to the table?**
-----------------------------------


We are on the lookout for a senior, strategic\-minded individual with a proven track record of managing large\-scale global accounts. You are proactive in initiating campaigns that not only meet but surpass client expectations regularly. You are an easy\-going person with a proactive, positive mindset and the resilience to navigate the complexities of global matrix organizations. As you will be overseeing several workstreams simultaneously, you are highly organized and can keep the big picture in focus while showing great attention to detail.


In addition, you have:


* 8\+ years of experience in Account Management or Project Management within CRM, digital marketing, or a related agency environment.
* Proven experience working with large global brands (experience in the luxury and/or automotive sectors is a massive advantage).
* Extensive experience leading teams and managing senior stakeholders across complex, global departments.
* Deep knowledge of what working with data, technical projects, and enterprise marketing automation platforms entails.
* Experience with the strategic management and implementation of IT projects within CRM, web, and/or marketing automation.
* Strong hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms, ideally Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Adobe Marketing Cloud.
* The competence, confidence, and self\-discipline to manage deadlines, estimates, and budgets excellently.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills in English.

**A leader in personalized customer experiences**
-------------------------------------------------


VML MAP is a world\-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer\-centric. Together, we are 1000 \+ technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55\+ nationalities.


**A global network**
--------------------


We are part of the global VML network that encompasses more than 30,000 employees across 150\+ offices in 60\+ markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences.


\#LI\-EMEA


WPP (VML MAP) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.


For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML MAP on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn *and* *X**.*


When you click “Apply now” below, your information is sent to VML MAP. To learn more about how we process your personal data during when you apply for a role with us, on how you can update your information or have the information removed please read our Privacy policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice.
